question: The India-UAE Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) was signed on 18th February 2022 by the Minister of and the Minister of ___ Economy of the UAE.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Commerce and Industry**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **India-UAE Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA)** was signed on 18th February 2022 between India and the United Arab Emirates.
 
• This **agreement was signed by Piyush Goyal, the Minister of Commerce and Industry of India, and Dr. Thani bin Ahmed Al Zeyoudi, the Minister of State for Foreign Trade in the UAE.**
 
• **The CEPA aims** to strengthen trade relations between the two countries, promote bilateral trade in goods and services, and increase investments.
 
• The **agreement is expected to boost trade in various sectors such as textiles, chemicals, electronics, and services, and provides new opportunities for businesses and investors in both nations.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Home Affairs:**

 
 
• This ministry is responsible for internal affairs, law and order, and security
 
• It deals with issues like **immigration**, **civil defense**, **disaster management**, and **counter-terrorism**.
 
 
 
• **Finance**:
 
 
• The Ministry of Finance deals with economic policies, government expenditure, and fiscal matters
 
• It oversees economic planning, financial institutions, and public debt management.
 
 
 
• ** External Affairs**:
 
 
• The Ministry of External Affairs manages diplomacy and foreign relations
 
• It deals with foreign policy, international treaties, and issues related to Indian citizens abroad.
